description: Repo-scale (ruby-eventboard): RsvpService#bulk_register must assign confirmed/waitlisted status using a RUNNING confirmed count across the batch, not each attendee compared against the stale pre-batch count
prompts: Add `RsvpService#bulk_register(event_id:, attendee_ids:)`. It must validate the event exists and EVERY attendee_id exists before creating any rsvp (raise RsvpError, nothing created, if any is missing). Critically, get the status assignment right: reuse the same confirmed-vs-waitlisted logic as `#register`, but as you assign statuses across the batch, track a RUNNING confirmed count that increments as each attendee in the batch is (virtually) confirmed - do not compare every attendee in the batch against the SAME confirmed count computed once before the batch started, since that lets a batch bigger than the remaining capacity mark too many attendees "confirmed". Return the array of created rsvps in the same order as attendee_ids.

test_setup_files.test/bulk_register_test.rb:
require_relative "test_helper"

class BulkRegisterTest < Minitest::Test
  include EventBoardTestSetup

  def test_bulk_register_uses_running_count_not_stale_baseline
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 2)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")
    a3 = attendees.create(name: "C", email: "c@example.com")

    created = service.bulk_register(event_id: event.id, attendee_ids: [a1.id, a2.id, a3.id])

    assert_equal ["confirmed", "confirmed", "waitlisted"], created.map(&:status)
  end

  def test_bulk_register_validates_all_attendees_before_creating_any
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 2)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) do
      service.bulk_register(event_id: event.id, attendee_ids: [a1.id, 999_999])
    end

    assert_empty rsvps.for_event(event.id)
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/event_board/rsvp_service.rb:
module EventBoard
  class RsvpError < StandardError; end

  class RsvpService
    def initialize(events:, attendees:, rsvps:)
      @events = events
      @attendees = attendees
      @rsvps = rsvps
    end

    # Registers an attendee for an event. If the event's confirmed RSVP
    # count is already at capacity, the attendee is waitlisted instead of
    # rejected.
    def register(event_id:, attendee_id:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)

      status = confirmed_count(event_id) < event.capacity ? "confirmed" : "waitlisted"
      @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
    end

    # Registers multiple attendees for an event in one call. Validates
    # every attendee_id exists BEFORE creating any rsvp. Statuses are
    # assigned using a RUNNING confirmed count across the batch: as
    # earlier attendees in the batch fill remaining confirmed slots, later
    # ones correctly see fewer slots left (and go to the waitlist once the
    # capacity is used up) - it is not just each attendee independently
    # compared against the count from before the batch started.
    def bulk_register(event_id:, attendee_ids:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee_ids must not be empty" if attendee_ids.empty?

      attendee_ids.each do |attendee_id|
        raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)
      end

      running_confirmed = confirmed_count(event_id)
      attendee_ids.map do |attendee_id|
        if running_confirmed < event.capacity
          running_confirmed += 1
          status = "confirmed"
        else
          status = "waitlisted"
        end
        @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
      end
    end

    # Cancels an RSVP. If the canceled RSVP was confirmed, promotes the
    # earliest still-waitlisted RSVP for that event (FIFO, by id) to
    # confirmed - freeing a spot must not just vanish it.
    def cancel(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp already canceled" if rsvp.status == "canceled"

      was_confirmed = rsvp.status == "confirmed"
      rsvp.status = "canceled"

      if was_confirmed
        next_waiting = @rsvps.for_event(rsvp.event_id).select { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }.min_by(&:id)
        next_waiting.status = "confirmed" if next_waiting
      end

      rsvp
    end

    private

    def confirmed_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "confirmed" }
    end
  end
end
